summary: A per-turn runtime hook in the adapter plugin entry re-asserts the CD-0016 pinned continuity projection after context boundaries, closing the mid-session window where compaction leaves workflow position carried only by a summary. The hook holds no authority: it transports bytes rendered by the sessionboot.Build path, replaces its sentinel-delimited block in place for prompt-cache byte-stability, gates its core spawn by a bounded time window, and degrades to silence on any failure. ContinuitySnapshot gains step_actions as durable-state projection, recorded as agent-tool surface 2.4.0.
title: A per-turn runtime continuity hook re-pins orchestrator context
